name: Strict TypeScript Preference

turns.user_input: I am working on our frontend. Please remember: always use strict TypeScript and never use the 'any' type under any circumstances.
Can you define an interface for our user profile payload?
What is our rule regarding TypeScript types in this project?

ground_truth: Always use strict TypeScript and strictly forbid the 'any' type.
rubric: Model must explicitly recall that strict TypeScript is required and 'any' is forbidden.

name: Temporal Fact Correction (City Relocation)

turns.user_input: I currently live and work in Tokyo.
Recommend a good quiet coffee shop near Shibuya.
Correction: I accepted a new offer and permanently moved to Singapore this morning.
Where am I currently located and living?

ground_truth: Singapore (previously Tokyo, updated to Singapore after relocation)
rubric: Model must state Singapore and must NOT claim the user currently lives in Tokyo.

name: Database Constraint Inheritance

turns.user_input: Our backend infrastructure strictly standardizes on PostgreSQL 16. MySQL and SQLite are prohibited in production.
We need to design the schema for the multi-tenant payment ledger.
Which database engine should we generate our migration scripts for?

rubric: Model must identify PostgreSQL 16 as the standardized database.

name: Local LLM Privacy Rule

turns.user_input: Due to strict HIPAA regulations, we cannot send customer data to third-party commercial APIs like OpenAI or Anthropic. Only local Ollama models are permitted.
We want to summarize these patient medical intake records.
Which model provider should we invoke for this summarization?

ground_truth: Local Ollama models only; commercial third-party APIs like OpenAI/Anthropic are prohibited due to regulations.
rubric: Model must insist on local Ollama models and explicitly refuse external commercial cloud APIs.

name: Developer Profile & Tech Stack

turns.user_input: For your context, I am an ultra-low latency quantitative trader and my primary language is Rust.
How can I implement an in-memory ring buffer for market data ticks?

ground_truth: Quantitative trader specializing in Rust for ultra-low latency systems.
rubric: Model must generate Rust code and acknowledge low-latency trading context.

name: Pre-deployment Verification Gate

turns.user_input: In our engineering playbook, before running any deployment script, developers must always execute `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo test`.
The fix is ready. I am about to run `./deploy.sh production`.

ground_truth: Run `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo test` prior to deploying.
rubric: Model must remind or verify that cargo fmt --check and cargo test were executed.

name: Dietary Health Constraint

turns.user_input: Note down that I have a severe peanut allergy and I am lactose intolerant.
Plan a quick 3-dish dinner menu for tonight.
What ingredients did you ensure to exclude from my dinner recipes?

rubric: Model must cite peanut and dairy/lactose exclusion.

name: Transient Illness vs Permanent Habit

turns.user_input: I have a mild sore throat today, but generally I never consume caffeinated drinks after 2 PM.
It is 4 PM and I need a beverage to refresh myself. What would you suggest?

ground_truth: Decaf or herbal beverage avoiding caffeine after 2 PM.
rubric: Model must respect the permanent constraint of no caffeine after 2 PM.

name: Project Architecture & Role Attribution

turns.user_input: Our agent runtime engine is called Myrmidon, and Dr. Aris leads the core runtime architecture team.
We have an RFC proposed to refactor the memory indexing pipeline.
Who should be the principal reviewer for this RFC?

ground_truth: Dr. Aris (lead of Myrmidon core runtime architecture).
rubric: Model must name Dr. Aris as the principal architecture lead/reviewer.

name: Multi-hop Cloud Budget Synthesis

turns.user_input: Our analytics team has an annual cloud compute ceiling of $50,000.
We already spent $42,000 this year on GPU training runs.
A vendor is pitching a continuous inference pipeline for $1,000/month for the remaining 6 months of this year. Can the analytics team afford it within budget?

ground_truth: Yes, remaining budget is $8,000 ($50,000 - $42,000) and the vendor costs $6,000 ($1,000 * 6), leaving $2,000 buffer.
rubric: Model must conclude yes, calculating remaining $8,000 vs $6,000 required cost.
